newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open flat, SingTel in block deal.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open flat, SingTel in block deal.

text.p: Singapore shares opened flat on Wednesday in quiet dealings.
Singapore Telecom (SingTel) saw 884,000 shares crossed at between Singapore $3.276 ($2.32) and S$3.278. Malaysia's Multi-Purpose was the most active with 1.2 million shares crossed at S$2.21.
Dealers said the market was very quiet despite the sharp fall in Wall Street stocks overnight.
After about 40 minutes of trading, the Straits Times Industrials index was off 0.95 points to 2,110.73. Volume was about 16 million units with 41 gainers against 23 losers.
"The Singapore market has bottomed. But there is just no fresh leads to head it up," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
"The market is holding as most of the weak holders have been flushed out. But institutions are also absent," he added.
Heading the top gainers were speculative Malaysian counters Innovest and Samanda while early losers include Singapore Press foreign and City Development.
